{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, confirm the format: look for commas
print(f"Sample of revenue with commas: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Replace commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print(f"Sample of cleaned revenue: {df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Check converted orders
converted_mask = df_clean['converted'] == 1
print(f"Number of converted orders: {converted_mask.sum()}")

# Filter for converted and completed orders
df_final = df_clean[converted_mask].copy()

# Final check: channel distribution
print(f"Final channel distribution: {df_final['channel'].value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
